terms.gloss: a footprint, a track; in the plural, a trail
evidence: Plaut. Cist. 4.2.29: hāc soccī videō vestīgium in pulvere (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Following someone’s trail is vestīgiīs sequī or persequī. For a trail that is a path, see path.

phrases.latin: hāc sit iter: manifesta rotae vestīgia cernēs
phrases.english: go this way: you’ll see the wheel-tracks plainly

phrases.latin: quia mē vestīgia terrent, omnia tē adversum spectantia, nūlla retrōrsum
phrases.english: because the tracks frighten me: all of them going in towards you, none coming back

sources: Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections (loci-ovidius, loci-horatius), checked against the editions named there.
